newsitem.title: USA: Video Update to acquire Superior Video.
newsitem.headline: Video Update to acquire Superior Video.

text.p: Video Update Inc, an international video chain, said Thursday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Superior Video, a 27-store video rental chain in British Columbia, Canada.
Terms were not disclosed. Completion of the purchase is subject to Canadian regulatory approval.

The company said it expects that operating results for the quarter ending April 30 will be helped by recognition of operating income and fees from the management of Superior Video and the availability of stronger new release titles such as "101 Dalmatians" during April.
However, Video Update said results could be hurt by the lack of public acceptance of weaker new release titles available for rental during February and March.
Results for the fiscal year ending April 30 will be released in late June, Video Update said.
